title: 25,000 cabs halt services from Hyderabad airport amid strike
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
key_facts: Telangana Gig and Platform Workers Union has begun a strike at Hyderabad airport, affecting cab services.
The union said long-pending issues behind the strike were raised with the government.
The union has asked the government for talks and a written resolution.

bullets_ur: Telangana Gig and Platform Workers Union ne Hyderabad airport par strike shuru ki hai, jis se cab services mutasir hain.

Union ne government se baat cheet aur likhit resolution ka mutalba kiya hai.
